source_name: Bloomberg Adria — Macedonian edition
why_relevant: Regional business outlet publishing in Macedonian; reported management changes at the top of NLB Banka Skopje. Combines local-language reporting with regional-standard business editing — high signal for appointments and M&A.

source_name: Provizii.mk — bank fee comparison portal
why_relevant: Not media but the structured counterpart to fee journalism: side-by-side comparison of Macedonian banks' commissions for individuals/businesses. Gives the underlying, checkable numbers behind MK fee-increase stories.

source_name: IT.mk forum — fintech threads
why_relevant: Practitioner/consumer forum with sustained threads on MK fintech and payment services; surfaces user-level complaints, app problems and early rumours of launches days before media pickup.

source_name: SeeNews — North Macedonia business news (EN)
why_relevant: English-language SEE business wire covering Macedonian bank results and corporate actions; the practical English bridge for MK-language filings, useful for cross-checking numbers reported in MK media.

source_name: w3newspapers / World-Newspapers — MK media directories
why_relevant: Directory listings of Macedonian newspapers and news sites — a cheap way to enumerate outlets (including regional and smaller titles) that keyword search alone will not surface, for completing the media map.

source_name: IMF — Republic of North Macedonia country page (Article IV staff reports, PLL reviews, press releases)
source_subtype: supranational country assessment / IFI staff report
why_relevant: Authoritative, dated English assessments of MK banking system soundness (NPLs, CAR, credit growth, real-estate exposures, bank resolution/EU-alignment agenda). Article IV staff reports and Executive Board press releases are recurring, comparable, and archived; the 2026 Article IV cycle is already published.

source_name: IMF eLibrary — Staff Country Reports (North Macedonia series)
why_relevant: Structured, citable archive of the full MK staff-report series (incl. informational annexes and selected-issues papers) with stable volume/issue identifiers — better for back-filling history than the news pages.

source_name: European Commission — DG Enlargement, North Macedonia Report (annual enlargement package, Ch.4/Ch.9 financial services)
why_relevant: Annual, dated EU assessment of MK preparedness in free movement of capital and financial services, payment systems, AML, and banking legislation alignment — the single best year-on-year comparable regulatory scorecard, with a stable publication rhythm (SWD numbering).

source_name: EEAS — EU Delegation to North Macedonia (enlargement package communications)
why_relevant: Localised EU messaging on the annual report and financial-sector reforms; often the fastest English pointer to the report and to related MK-specific EU announcements.

source_name: bne IntelliNews — Southeast Europe banking/fintech coverage
why_relevant: Analytical English coverage of SEE banking ownership shifts and investor geography that frames MK deals in a regional context (e.g. Turkish, Hungarian, Slovenian bank expansion into MK).

source_name: World Bank — Western Balkans Regular Economic Report (semi-annual, MK country note)
why_relevant: Semi-annual comparable regional benchmarking including a financial-sector section and per-country MK factsheets; recent editions cover digital-payments adoption (MK ~75% in 2024) — directly relevant to payments workstreams.

source_name: World Bank — SEPA / Western Balkans payments features and country news
why_relevant: Narrative and quantified framing of MK's SEPA accession impact on cross-border payment costs — useful analytical context that local sources rarely quantify.

source_name: EBRD — North Macedonia country strategy, diagnostic and Transition Report country assessment
why_relevant: EBRD country diagnostics and annual Transition Report country assessments narrate MK financial-sector reform steps with dates (credit-risk methodology 2023, LTV/DSTI caps 2023, bank resolution law Oct 2023) and score transition qualities — a comparable annual analytical series.

source_name: EIB — CESEE Bank Lending Survey (Vienna Initiative 2.0)
why_relevant: Twice-yearly survey of ~15 international banking groups and ~85 local subsidiaries, covering North Macedonia — supplies cross-border parent-bank intentions, credit supply/demand and subsidiary profitability signals not available from MK sources.

source_name: Vienna Initiative (European Bank Coordination Initiative) — forums and deleveraging monitor
why_relevant: Coordination body whose Full Forums (one hosted in Skopje) and working-group papers surface cross-border bank funding, NPL and payments-integration topics for MK; a hub pointing to EIB/EBRD/IMF/central-bank contributions.

source_name: Fitch Ratings — Republic of North Macedonia sovereign and bank rating actions
why_relevant: Rating actions and rating-action commentaries carry a standing banking-system assessment (NPL ratio, CAR, ROAE, sector stability) plus forward-looking risk framing on the euro peg and credit growth; MK LTFC IDR affirmed at 'BB+' stable in recent actions.

source_name: S&P Global Ratings — North Macedonia sovereign credit rating and research
why_relevant: Second independent rating opinion (MK affirmed 'BB-/B', stable) with banking-system commentary; S&P's BICRA-style views on the MK banking system are the closest thing to an external systemic risk score.

source_name: S&P Global Market Intelligence — SEE/Emerging Europe banking news headlines
why_relevant: Carries dated English write-ups of MK bank results and outlooks (e.g. a Komercijalna Banka profit-outlook item), giving an independent English record of company disclosures.

source_name: BIS — Central Bankers' Speeches archive (NBRNM governor speeches in English)
why_relevant: Systematically archives English translations of NBRNM Governor speeches on payments modernisation, SEPA accession, banking soundness and Vienna Initiative — a durable, dated, free English mirror of MK central-bank strategic messaging.

source_name: European Payments Council — SEPA scheme participation news and register
why_relevant: Definitive, dated English record of MK entry into SEPA scheme geographical scope (March 2025) and of which MK PSPs adhere to SCT/SCT Inst/SDD — the authoritative registry for MK payments-actor mapping from outside.

source_name: The Paypers — payments industry news (MK/Western Balkans items)
why_relevant: Payments-specialist English tracker that picks up MK payments milestones (SEPA admission, PSP launches) and places them in a European payments-industry frame; useful for vendor/scheme-level signals a banking wire would miss.

source_name: European Western Balkans (EWB) — EU-integration news portal
why_relevant: Regional English portal that summarises the annual EC report key findings for MK and covers financial-integration steps (SEPA implementation) quickly and with links back to primary EU documents — an efficient pointer layer.

source_name: BIRN / Balkan Insight — banking investigations tag
why_relevant: Investigative English coverage (incl. the cross-border 'Breaking the Bank' series with a Macedonia reporter) that surfaces ownership, governance and misuse issues in MK banking that regulated disclosures omit.

source_name: ProCredit Holding AG — group investor relations (North Macedonia segment reporting)
why_relevant: Frankfurt-listed parent publishes English annual, quarterly and disclosure reports with an explicit North Macedonia segment (loan volume, growth, NPL ratio, headcount) plus product/channel news such as the MK mobile-banking app launch — an internationally-filed, audited mirror of a MK bank's performance.

source_name: NLB Group (Ljubljana) — investor relations / financial reports (NLB Banka Skopje, NLB Komercijalna)
why_relevant: Owner of the largest MK banking franchise; English group annual and interim reports carry MK member-bank results, market commentary and strategic intent — the highest-quality English disclosure channel on MK's leading bank.

source_name: financialreports.eu — aggregated European issuer filings (e.g. NLB)
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator of European issuer filings; useful as an index/back-fill route to parent-group reports covering MK subsidiaries when IR sites reorganise their URLs.

source_name: thebanks.eu — North Macedonia bank profiles and rankings
why_relevant: English aggregator normalising MK bank balance-sheet data, ownership and rankings into comparable profiles — a fast actor-map builder, though derived and lagging; must be cross-checked against NBRNM/bank disclosures.
